points.title: Payments
points.body: Payments can only be accepted via PayPal, and revolut. Any orders under €15 must be sent through friends and family, or alternative, where customer occurs any fees or extra charges.

bullets.text: Customer agrees to pay the due amount when the sketch is provided, at latest for any orders of value lower, or equal to €75
On orders above €75 cutomer has the option of agreeing on a payment plan, if 50% is put as a down payment, and this is agreed with myself before hand.
Cutomer accepts that the item will not be delivered if payment is not completed in full.

points.title: What Can / Will I draw
points.body:
Simple backgrounds are included in charged price
Detailed Backgrounds, or scenes may Incur a 50% price increase. 
Extra Characters may be added, for 75% of the original price
Suggestive pieces may Incur up to a 25% price increase
NSFW pieces may Incur up to a 50% price increase

points.title: Revisions
points.body: Abuse of revisions or purposefully vague requests to garner more revisions will result in termination of any order.

bullets.text: Customer accepts that they have three total revisions during the sketch and line phase.
A revision is only used, when I fail to provide a sketch to the requests guidelines, IE; wrong expression, or incorrect markings.

revisions during colour and render phase, may only retain to markings, or detail added during colour phase. Customer accepts that no changes to line art, may be made during the colour stage. Same follows for any rendering

points.title: Currency Conversions
points.body: Customer Agrees to pay the total amount specified in Euro, and it is the sole responsibility of the Customer to bear any currency conversion costs.

points.title: Refunds
points.body: Refunds May be offered in the case the Customer changes their mind about the commission or my style, ONLY if I have not provided the next stage in the commission process, IE; cleaned sketch / line art / coloured sketch. If any refund is requested before this deadline, an 80% refund may be issued. This policy may be amended at any time for any reason, given extenuating circumstances from the Customer

points.title: Personal and Commercial Use
points.body:
Any product received by Customer is for personal use only. Any use of the product for commercial purposes has to be approved beforehand by the seller. This will require a separate agreement, defining exact use, and any further commercial costs, up to a 50% fee. 
Any Product intended for social media use, IE; profile banner, Emotes, or Bio panels, will not incur extra fees, but please make this clear in your order.

points.title: Cancellations
points.body:
I reserve every right to refuse, or cancel any order, under condition of full refund, without giving reason to the Customer.
Any Disrespectful behavior, suspicious activity, or breach of these terms, will not be tolerated, and may result in customer being refused sales in the future.
Due to the nature of custom commissions, notably Custom designs, Customer will not be eligible for any refunds if the designs / pieces have been delivered.

points.title: Delivery
points.body: Final Product and updates will typically be sent via our primary communication channel. Delivery via email is offered at request of customer.
